caseName: United States ex rel. Innes v. Crystal
caseNameFull: United States ex rel. Innes v. Crystal, Commanding Officer
attorneys: Peter J. Innes, Jr., pro se. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Berge, and Mr. Oscar A. Provost for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied on the ground that the cause is moot, it appearing that petitioner no longer is in respondent’s custody, Zimmerman v. Walker, ante, p. 744, and cases cited.
